idea-plugin.name: Dumpie
idea-plugin.description:
See dump(), dd(), log records and ray() output in a tool window instead of the browser or laravel.log. Every entry links to the line that produced it.

Get started in a minute

  1. Install the plugin and open your project.
  2. Add one line to .env, or press Add to .env in the Dumpie tool window: VAR_DUMPER_FORMAT=server
  3. Call dump($order). It shows up in the tool window.

Projects with spatie/ray or spatie/laravel-ray need no setup at all. Just quit the Ray desktop app: both listen on port 23517. In Docker or Sail, also set VAR_DUMPER_SERVER=host.docker.internal:9912.

What you get

  • dump() and dd(): expandable dumps colored with your editor scheme. Works in any project with symfony/var-dumper, which comes with Laravel and Symfony.
  • Log files: new records from storage/logs or var/log as they are written, colored by level, with the stack trace.
  • ray(): tables, queries, events, jobs, mails, models, exceptions, measure(), pause(), colors and screens.
  • Exceptions with the code around the failing line; vendor frames are folded.
  • Jump to code: click File.php:42. Docker and Sail paths are mapped to your project.

Many projects, many IDEs

  • One session per project, so output never mixes. Unread counters show where something new arrived.
  • Open any project's session from any window, or see All projects in one feed.
  • PhpStorm and WebStorm open together? Output reaches the window that has the project open.

Made for reading

  • Filter by color or text, pause the feed, collapse entries.
  • Copy any entry as a Markdown code block for chats and issues.
  • Light and dark themes and fonts follow the IDE.

Dumpie listens on 127.0.0.1 only, so nothing leaves your machine. Free and open source (MIT). If Dumpie saves you time, you can support it on Boosty.

Dumpie is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Spatie. Ray and spatie/ray are products of Spatie.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0

  • First release: dump()/dd() via VarDumper server mode, log file following, spatie/ray compatibility.
  • Per-project sessions with an All projects feed, color filters, search, pause, copy as Markdown.
  • Settings page with project auto-detection and setup hints in the empty tool window.
  • Output is routed between several IDEs running Dumpie at the same time.
